audience: email marketers and small business owners who send newsletters with Mailchimp

useCases.title: Compare how your campaigns performed
useCases.text: The AI lists campaign reports and opens one with opens, clicks, bounces and unsubscribes. It compares campaigns and points out the best and weakest.

useCases.title: Check the size of each audience
useCases.text: The AI lists audiences and reads one with its subscriber stats and default from-name and email. You see which lists are large.

useCases.title: Look up a subscriber and their tags
useCases.text: The AI searches members by email or name and reads one member's status, merge fields and tags. You learn if a person is subscribed.

useCases.title: Add or update a subscriber
useCases.text: The AI adds a new member to an audience or updates an existing one by email. A pending status sends a double opt-in email.

useCases.title: Tag or archive subscribers one by one
useCases.text: The AI adds or removes tags on a member, or archives the member. Archive is a soft removal and not a permanent delete.
